visualCharacteristics: Two side-by-side informational columns on a recipe detail page. Left: Ingredients (heading + bulleted list + ready-in/serving metadata rows). Right: Directions (heading + numbered steps + a serving note). Stacks vertically on mobile.
contentPattern: One row, two columns. Column 1 = Ingredients (heading, list, metadata). Column 2 = Directions (heading, numbered steps, note). Icons render as inline images.
usage: Recipe body on recipe detail pages (ingredients vs directions).
